course.title: Reinforced Concrete Structures - II
course.department: Department of Building Engineering and Construction Management

content.value: A building is designed using a flat plate floor system is composed of slab panels measuring 24 ft x 20 ft. Beams, drop panals and column capitals are not permitted. Specified live load is 60 psi and dead load will include the weight of the slab plus 25 psf for floor finish pius suspended loads. Masonry wall of 5 inch thick continuous along the grid lines. The column wil be 24 inch square, and the floor to floor height of the structure will be 11 ft. Design the interior panel, using materials strengths $f _ { c } ^ { \prime }$ = 3000 psi and $\vec { \mathcal { T } _ { y } } = 6 0 , 0 0 0$ psi.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
